overview: Markets: Sensex sank 1,000 points to a 2026 low and rupee hit 96.31 as RBI's rate decision looms.
Big story: Brazil votes in a knife-edge election pitting Lula against Bolsonaro's son, with a runoff likely.

items.headline: US job growth stalls badly, lifting Fed rate-cut bets
items.summary: US employers added just 29,000 jobs in September, far below forecasts of 84,000, as unemployment rose to 4.2% and wage growth slowed to its weakest annual pace since 2021. The weak report strengthens the case for further Fed rate cuts.

items.headline: Brazil votes in knife-edge Lula vs Bolsonaro election
items.summary: Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro closed tight campaigns before Sunday's first-round vote, with polls showing Lula's lead narrowing and a runoff likely. The result will shape Brazil's stance on US-China trade rivalry and debt policy.

items.headline: Trump signals Iran decision as Yemen conflict escalates
items.summary: Trump said a decision on Iran is coming "the easy way or the hard way" as Yemeni government forces struck Houthi-held Sanaa, raising fears of wider US military involvement days after a Senate war-powers resolution to limit his authority narrowly failed.

items.headline: Russia strikes second major Kyiv bridge in two days
items.summary: A Russian drone strike hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge, cutting trolleybus power and suspending traffic for a third straight day of disruption, a day after the Southern Bridge was hit five times. Moscow says it is targeting military logistics routes.

items.headline: Israeli strikes kill Palestinians in Gaza despite ceasefire
items.summary: An Israeli air attack on a Gaza City apartment killed at least five Palestinians, with eight dead across the strip on Saturday, as Hamas accused Israel of undermining the fragile US-backed ceasefire deal.

items.headline: UAE says FlyDubai co-pilot's axe attack was terrorism
items.summary: UAE's prosecutor general said a FlyDubai co-pilot attacked Indian captain Smit Machchhar with a crash axe and tried to seize the controls on a Sept 30 Dubai-Tel Aviv flight. The Omani national had earlier been barred from flying by Oman over radical views; the plane diverted safely to Saudi Arabia.

items.headline: Two Iranians charged in UK over plot against Jewish community
items.summary: Two Iranian nationals appeared in a London court charged with planning an attack targeting the Jewish community in northern England, amid growing concern in Britain over Iran-linked threats.

items.headline: Bosnia votes in election that could reshape its EU path
items.summary: Around 3.5 million Bosnians voted Sunday for a tri-partite presidency and parliaments amid an economic slowdown and stalled EU membership talks. Republika Srpska's push for autonomy is straining the country's postwar political settlement.

items.headline: Somalia rejects alleged Israeli naval base plan in Berbera
items.summary: Somalia's president said Israel is planning a naval base in Berbera, Somaliland, and wants to use its airport, vowing Mogadishu "won't accept an Israeli presence under any circumstances." It reflects rising friction since Israel recognised Somaliland's independence.

items.headline: North Korea fires ballistic missile amid border tensions
items.summary: North Korea test-fired an intermediate-range ballistic missile it says can evade missile defences, with Kim Jong Un's sister calling it a strategic, nuclear-capable weapon. The two Koreas are trading blame over border landmine blasts that injured South Korean soldiers.

items.headline: Egypt and Ethiopia expel each other's diplomats
items.summary: Egypt and Ethiopia expelled senior diplomats in a tit-for-tat escalation rooted in the decade-long Nile dam dispute, a day after Ethiopia closed its Eritrea embassy and expelled ten Eritrean diplomats. The African Union has called for restraint.

items.headline: Tens of thousands protest across Spain over housing crisis
items.summary: Demonstrators marched in Madrid and about 50 other cities after Spain's parliament voted down PM Pedro Sanchez's decrees to freeze rents and curb evictions. Clashes broke out with police in Valencia, and Sanchez may now call a snap election.

items.headline: Nearly 1,000 detained in Delhi protest against poll body chief
items.summary: Delhi Police detained around 1,000 demonstrators, including AAP and opposition leaders, at a Jantar Mantar protest demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged irregularities in the special revision of electoral rolls. Prohibitory orders and an internet suspension were imposed nearby.

items.headline: Gujarat's Uniform Civil Code gets presidential assent
items.summary: President Droupadi Murmu gave assent to Gujarat's Uniform Civil Code Bill, making it the second state after Uttarakhand to enact common laws on marriage, divorce, succession and live-in relationships. The BJP called it a step toward equality; Congress criticised the move, with tribal communities exempted.

items.headline: Congress alleges Modi knew of EC curbs on poll access
items.summary: Congress alleged that Prime Minister Modi was aware of the Election Commission's IT division restricting electoral registration officers' access to the ECINet portal, intensifying the opposition's standoff with the poll body over the Special Intensive Revision of voter rolls.

items.headline: Kharge seeks Rs 3,705 crore drought relief for Karnataka
items.summary: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge wrote to PM Modi seeking Rs 3,705 crore in central drought relief for Karnataka, as the state grapples with crop losses; a separate Dharwad district plan is focusing on water, fodder and emergency jobs for affected farmers.

items.headline: Dharwad district ramps up drought relief on water, jobs
items.summary: Karnataka's Dharwad district administration is stepping up drought-relief measures focused on water supply, fodder for livestock and emergency jobs, as the region deals with crop failure this season alongside the state's wider push for central disaster funds.

items.headline: Seven more arrested in Bollaram army arms theft case
items.summary: Telangana police arrested seven more people, including three serving army personnel, in connection with the theft of arms from the Madras Regiment's 20th Battalion at Bollaram, widening a security investigation into the breach.

items.headline: Parents allege ashram hid missing teen for three months
items.summary: Parents of a 17-year-old who took "diksha" from spiritual guru Premanand Maharaj protested outside his Vrindavan ashram, alleging it concealed their son's whereabouts since he went missing on July 3, raising fresh questions about oversight of religious institutions.

items.headline: Bitchat app vanishes from Indian stores after govt order
items.summary: Jack Dorsey's offline messaging app Bitchat disappeared from Apple and Google's app stores in India after New Delhi ordered its removal under Section 69A of the IT Act, the government's primary legal tool for blocking online content.

items.headline: Gadkari approves Rs 467 crore for Shivamogga bypass
items.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari announced Rs 466.74 crore in approval for the remaining 4.74-km stretch of the four-lane Shivamogga city bypass in Karnataka, part of the government's continuing highway-expansion push in the state.

items.headline: Sensex sinks 1,000 points to 2026 low on F&O expiry
items.summary: The Sensex fell as much as 1,000 points intraday to hit a 2026 low near 71,742, while the Nifty slid to about 22,300, hurt by F&O expiry volatility and rising oil prices ahead of the RBI's policy meeting this week.

items.headline: Rupee slumps to two-month low of 96.31 against dollar
items.summary: The rupee slumped 37 paise to close at a provisional 96.31 against the US dollar, its weakest level in two months, as surging crude oil prices, foreign fund outflows and elevated US bond yields weighed on the currency.

items.headline: RBI policy meet begins; economists expect a rate hike
items.summary: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee meets October 5-7, with most economists polled expecting a 25-basis-point repo rate hike to 5.50% as rising inflation, costlier energy and global central bank moves push the case for tighter policy.

items.headline: Groww files confidential IPO papers, seeks up to $1 billion
items.summary: Groww's parent Billionbrains Garage Ventures filed draft IPO papers via SEBI's confidential route, seeking to raise up to $1 billion in a listing that could value the trading-app company at $7-8 billion, backed by Peak XV and Microsoft's Satya Nadella.

items.headline: Karnataka courts South Korean investors in tech push
items.summary: Karnataka IT Minister Priyank Kharge met a high-level South Korean business delegation to discuss technology partnerships and industrial investment, part of the state's push to deepen trade ties with Korean firms.

items.headline: Wall Street hits records as soft jobs data lifts bets on cuts
items.summary: US stocks rose Friday, with the Nasdaq touching an intraday record led by Nvidia, as softer-than-expected September jobs data boosted investor bets that the Federal Reserve will keep cutting interest rates.

items.headline: Critical FortiMail zero-day added to CISA exploited list
items.summary: CISA added a critical Fortinet FortiMail flaw (CVE-2026-104286, CVSS 9.8) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after attackers used it to write arbitrary files on unpatched systems, prompting urgent patch orders for federal agencies.

items.headline: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN flaw added to CISA's exploited list
items.summary: CISA flagged an actively exploited authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (CVE-2026-76504, CVSS 9.8) that lets unauthenticated attackers gain admin access, adding it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.headline: GitLab patches critical flaw in its AI Gateway
items.summary: GitLab patched a critical flaw (CVE-2026-90970, CVSS 9.9) in its AI Gateway that could let a logged-in user with Duo Agent Platform access run arbitrary commands on self-hosted servers, urging customers to update immediately.

items.headline: Hackers found disguising Citrix NetScaler web shells as CSS
items.summary: Researchers detailed a post-exploitation payload on compromised Citrix NetScaler devices that creates a hidden superuser account and maps a web shell to CSS-like URLs, letting attackers blend persistent backdoor access into normal-looking web traffic.

items.headline: OpenAI safety employee resigns, cites 'broken' culture
items.summary: An OpenAI safety staffer who led writing of safety reports for major product launches resigned, saying the company's culture around safety has broken down, adding to recent departures and scrutiny of how AI labs balance speed against risk.

items.headline: Judge calls Flock surveillance tool 'indiscriminate'
items.summary: A federal judge ruled that a sheriff's deputy violated a woman's Fourth Amendment rights by using the Flock license-plate-reading system without a warrant, calling the technology "indiscriminate mass surveillance" in a ruling with implications for US policing tech.

items.headline: WordPress backdoor rebuilds itself after being cleaned up
items.summary: Researchers found a WordPress backdoor that persists by hiding copies of itself across files, the site database and shared memory, automatically rebuilding whichever piece a cleanup effort removes, making standard malware removal largely ineffective.

items.headline: Fossil hints dinosaurs evolved flight more than once
items.summary: A 57-centimetre feathered microraptorine fossil found in China's Liaoning province shows limb features suggesting flight evolved independently in multiple dinosaur lineages between 145 million and 100 million years ago, not from one common ancestor.

items.headline: SpaceX's Crew-13 docks at ISS in record time
items.summary: SpaceX's Crew-13 mission launched four astronauts to the International Space Station on October 1, docking less than eight hours after liftoff and setting a new speed record for a US crewed spacecraft reaching the orbital outpost.

items.headline: US measles cases near 4,000 as Pennsylvania outbreak grows
items.summary: US measles infections are closing in on 4,000 cases, with Pennsylvania adding more than 100 new cases in a week and emerging as the nation's hotspot, over two-thirds of them among adults, health researchers reported.

items.headline: Study finds amino acid leucine powers up cell energy
items.summary: Researchers found the essential amino acid leucine boosts cellular energy production by protecting key mitochondrial proteins from degradation, a discovery that could point to new treatment approaches for metabolic disorders and some cancers.

items.headline: India beat Pakistan to win Asian Games cricket gold
items.summary: India beat Pakistan by 19 runs in the Asian Games men's T20 cricket final, with Abhishek Sharma and Tilak Varma smashing half-centuries before Hasan Nawaz's 96 for Pakistan fell short in a tense chase at Nisshin.

items.headline: Gill's record 223 not out seals India's ODI chase
items.summary: Shubman Gill smashed 223 not out off 133 balls, the fastest ODI double century ever, as India chased down 406 to beat West Indies in the second ODI, a day that also produced five individual centuries in one match.

items.headline: Shai Hope's century seals record West Indies ODI chase
items.summary: West Indies beat India by five wickets in the third ODI at Mullanpur, with captain Shai Hope's unbeaten century completing a record run-chase and denying India a series sweep.

items.headline: India complete hockey double at Asian Games 2026
items.summary: India's men's team defended their Asian Games hockey title by beating Malaysia 5-1, securing direct qualification for the LA 2028 Olympics, while the women's team beat China 1-0 to end a 44-year wait for Asiad gold.

items.headline: South Korea beat Japan for fourth straight football gold
items.summary: South Korea beat hosts Japan 1-0 in the Asian Games men's football final, with Eom Ji-sung's second-half strike securing a fourth consecutive title and lifting spirits after a difficult World Cup cycle.

items.headline: Asian Games 2026 conclude with China topping medal table
items.summary: The Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya concluded with China topping the table on 119 gold and 205 total medals, while India finished third with a record 85 medals: 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze.

items.headline: Zverev, Medvedev advance at China Open in Beijing
items.summary: Top seed Alexander Zverev and Daniil Medvedev reached the China Open quarterfinals in Beijing, while Alex de Minaur battled back from a set down in a near three-hour win over qualifier Quentin Halys.
